document.reference_owner: Independent neutral fixture/oracle author before SDK admission
document.purpose: Controlled native protocol qualification only; no business task or business-defect credit

provenance.expected_values_source: Already sealed neutral fixture and five-state original oracle; no captured values or candidate code

obligations.clause: Each selected state exposes the exact marker from its current fixed fixture input.
Each selected state exposes the exact lower detail from its current fixed fixture input.
The counter starts at zero, becomes one after one successful primary activation, and stays one across caller replacement and last activation.
Primary and last controls are uniquely present and enabled with their fixed native labels.
The demonstrated primary native activation produces exactly one probe.primary callback in its original interval.
The demonstrated caller update advances input exactly once in the same app/process and produces no callback in its original interval.
The demonstrated lower last native activation produces exactly one probe.last callback in its original interval.
Start and replacement-full have native state-local overlapping top-to-bottom coverage, bottom sentinel, all eighteen fixed row labels, and lower detail/last targets.

The nonempty mounted-component token remains equal across the five states and caller replacement, separately from observer app/process/input/event identity. No documented comparison provider exists yet.

responsibilities.clause: Actual compatible generated control checks establish only the component native labels/control facts in their approved states.
responsibilities.subject: probe-component

responsibilities.clause: Actual generated callback checks require real native stimulus and original bound intervals; source is not callback execution proof.
responsibilities.subject: probe-component

responsibilities.clause: Static source review: the thin observer bridge decodes required marker/detail strings and directly calls the imported NativeQualificationProbe with those strings and the original onEvent closure; it owns no probe UI, state, controls or callback implementation. This claim does not prove runtime execution or mounted-component identity.
responsibilities.subject: thin-bridge

capture_validity_approval.approved_scope: Only this sealed neutral modular fixture, fixed action route, scalar inputs and pinned dependency environment. No extension to business apps, network/time-dependent state or unknown dependencies.
capture_validity_approval.reason: Both components reset deterministic scalar state in a fresh native fixture, execute fixed callbacks/updates and contain no external services. The random mounted token is recorded identity, not an external business-state input. Original package identity, current source, all coverage and unresolved U remain mandatory.
capture_validity_approval.limitations: Any relevant source/input/bridge/toolchain/environment/coverage/expectation drift, unknown dependency impact or age over 3600 seconds makes reuse ineligible; a live simulator does not reset evidence age.

resource_selection.selection_status: Specified by admission task; installed inventory and actual runtime/toolchain proof remain unverified

trust_limit: Identity and exact typed derivation only. Authorship, design correctness and approval require a separate preimplementation review record.
